[comment by gliscowo (member)]
You're trying to use a 1.20.5 version of owo on 1.21.1 - this will quite obviously not work. Instead, use a modern version like [0.12.13 for 1.21](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib/version/0.12.13+1.21)

Cheers
